assumptions.statement: SITE-001 and all three key-area polygons are provisional working geometries, not official redlines.
assumptions.impact: All exact siting, parcel, station-interface, demolition, and statutory claims are blocked; geometry-derived metrics are low-confidence reference calculations.

assumptions.statement: Approved FAR, height, coverage, green ratio, setbacks, road redlines, heritage controls, ownership, and facility standards are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: The proposal supplies a decision protocol and reference scheme, not regulatory controls.

assumptions.statement: The 10 nodes and 24 candidate edges are normalized hypotheses inside the provisional work frame, not surveyed origins, destinations, or rights of way.
assumptions.impact: Ensemble values measure reproducible model behavior only and cannot be presented as observed accessibility or transport demand.

assumptions.statement: Length, equity, climate, heritage-review, and maintenance weights are human-set scenario choices varied over disclosed ranges.
assumptions.impact: No model consensus can override rights, safety, heritage, accessibility, affordability, or professional review.

assumptions.statement: No approved aggregate priority-population, essential-service, or OD dataset is present.
assumptions.impact: Distributional equity remains untested; proxy scores are questions for later community and professional study.

assumptions.statement: No authoritative flood, heat, drainage-capacity, ecological-baseline, or future-climate layer is present.
assumptions.impact: Blue-green geometry is a conceptual performance brief, not a hydraulic or habitat claim.

assumptions.statement: Building polygons are reversible ground-floor prototype envelopes, not an existing building survey or total proposed floor area.
assumptions.impact: No parcel demolition decision, FAR, height, or total capacity is inferred.

assumptions.statement: Any spatial action begins as a reversible, time-bounded pilot with a named owner, stop rule, non-digital fallback, and post-pilot recovery plan.
assumptions.impact: Scale-up requires observable accessibility, equity, heritage, safety, maintenance, and public-review evidence.
